transcript:
Here is your AI Research Pulse update.

This month, AI labs are showcasing significant advancements in core model capabilities, pushing scientific boundaries, and rapidly integrating AI into global enterprise.

OpenAI leads with **GPT-5.2**, its strongest model yet for math and science, setting state-of-the-art benchmarks and even solving open theoretical problems. It’s also hailed as its most advanced frontier model for professional work, driving reliable agentic workflows. Complementing this, **ChatGPT Images** received a major upgrade, now delivering precise edits, consistent details, and up to 4x faster generation, while improved **Gemini audio models** promise powerful voice experiences.

In scientific research, AI is proving transformative. OpenAI launched **FrontierScience**, a benchmark for AI reasoning in physics, chemistry, and biology, alongside a framework to measure AI’s acceleration of real-world biological research, including optimizing molecular cloning. Microsoft's **GigaTIME** uses AI to uncover cellular patterns for cancer treatment, and Google DeepMind leveraged **AlphaFold** to engineer resilient, heat-tolerant crops.

Enterprise adoption is exploding. OpenAI announced a multi-year AI transformation with **BBVA**, rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise to 120,000 employees. Similar large-scale deployments are happening with **BNY, Deutsche Telekom, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia**, aiming for AI-native banking, improved workflows, and enhanced customer service. **Disney** will bring its iconic characters to Sora, emphasizing responsible AI in entertainment, and **Instacart** is integrating AI for seamless grocery shopping. Retailers like **Podium** and **Scout24** are seeing massive revenue growth and reimagined customer interactions using GPT-5.

Developer tools are also evolving rapidly. OpenAI co-founded the **Agentic AI Foundation** to foster open standards. Microsoft introduced **Agent Lightning**, simplifying reinforcement learning integration into AI agents with minimal code, and **Promptions**, for precise, dynamic UI controls in chat interfaces. OpenAI's **Codex** famously helped ship Sora for Android in just 28 days, highlighting rapid development.

Safety, alignment, and interpretability remain core focuses. Anthropic continues its research into **Alignment and Interpretability**. OpenAI updated its **GPT-5.2 System Card**, reinforced its commitment to **cyber resilience** as AI capabilities advance, and Google DeepMind deepened its partnership with the **UK AI Security Institute**. Google Research also introduced the **FACTS Benchmark Suite** for evaluating LLM factuality and a differentially private framework for chatbot use.

Finally, the broader societal impact and education are in focus. OpenAI is launching **certifications and AI Foundations courses** to upskill workers globally, including a major initiative for **Australia**. They also reflected on **ten years** of progress, remaining optimistic about AGI benefiting humanity. Anthropic interviewed 1,250 professionals about working with AI, providing valuable insights into human-AI collaboration.

That's your AI Research Pulse update. Stay informed, stay curious.
